symbols.name: base-2 logarithm
symbols.meaning: The base-2 logarithm of the positive integer $n$ under the paper's convention, which is at least 1.
symbols.quote: The base-2 logarithm, written $\lg n$, is a special case of the [Logarithm](logarithm.md) with the base fixed at 2.

symbols.name: bound constant
symbols.meaning: The fixed constant $2^{-182}$ in the paper's running-time bound.
symbols.quote: The constant $\kappa$ is the fixed value $2^{-182}$ in that bound, which says that exact multiplication of two $n$-bit integers takes $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ time.

relations.quote: The base-2 logarithm, written $\lg n$, is a special case of the [Logarithm](logarithm.md) with the base fixed at 2.
